title: Burnell's charm, jealousy and winning a New York job
summary: Women doted on Burnell at clubs; Dejan wishes he were alive, and recalls the band winning a job on the way to New York by Burnell's piano chorus.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Then he was jealous of the boy, changed suits two, three times. Any time he'd go home he'd come out and let a suit and change him and just like, you felt like changing him. And you know how it is, I mean, you get to the point you get jealous of one and wondering why he getting the clothes from. How he's guilty. But everybody was just crazy about him, that's all. Just like a little child. When he'd come in the club and when I was playing the gypsy team with Kid Renee, he'd come in the club, I mean all the girls are hugging him, you know, take him and sit boy down on their lap and play in his hand. Everybody thought he was a little doll or something. That's where they handled it. I said I wish he was living today because I ain't know nobody right now can play the piano like he used to play nothing around here.
He never made a record I guess except his family may have some acetate probably would be on his track stuff.
I could find out, I'll find out for you, you know, when he died and I don't know.
Lester I think maybe told us a few dates on him or else his sister went on there, one of his sisters, he said you'd tell us more about him.

Yeah, well like his oldest sister, the Chinese never read her, they came up with him, they know a lot about him too, but maybe the oldest sister would tell you a lot about him. But everywhere we'd play. I told you about when we first went for this job, what happened? Which?
On the Dixon. Oh yes, you mean on the way to New York.

Soon we played the theme song everybody stood up and asked if I wanted the job. We played the theme song and the boy played the second chorus on the piano and everybody stood up and said never heard nothing like that.
